faultInjectionHistory.observedBehavior: Mock background worker terminated unexpectedly. Process supervisor restarted child process in 420ms. Incomplete job redelivered via Dead Letter Queue.
faultInjectionHistory.userFacingErrorMessage: Background task delayed slightly but finished successfully.
recommendations: Ensure idempotent background job processors so re-delivered messages do not create duplicates.
Monitor Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) alerts for messages failing more than 3 retry attempts.

faultInjectionHistory.observedBehavior: Simulated packet latency variance between 100ms and 800ms. No connection resets; TCP retransmissions handled cleanly by client adapter.
recommendations: Tune keep-alive socket timeouts to prevent stale socket reuse under jitter.
Ensure HTTP client connection pool maintains reasonable maxIdleSockets.

faultInjectionHistory.observedBehavior: Mock third-party microservice returned HTTP 503. Exponential backoff with jitter attempted 3 retries before returning fallback response.
faultInjectionHistory.userFacingErrorMessage: External service is currently unavailable. Cached information is being displayed.
recommendations: Ensure all third-party integrations have resilient retry policies with exponential jitter.
Return stale-while-revalidate cached responses when external APIs fail.

faultInjectionHistory.observedBehavior: Simulated ECONNREFUSED on primary database. Circuit breaker tripped after 3 consecutive connection drops. Mock application returned structured 503 Service Unavailable.
faultInjectionHistory.userFacingErrorMessage: Service temporarily undergoing maintenance. Please retry in 30 seconds.
recommendations: Configure automatic failover to hot-standby database within 15 seconds.
Ensure health-check endpoint (/api/health) reports database degradation to load balancer.
Implement an in-memory fallback cache for read-only user views during database outages.

faultInjectionHistory.observedBehavior: Database query latency artificially delayed by 1500ms. Mock pool queued 14 transactions. Connection timeout handled gracefully by application layer.
faultInjectionHistory.userFacingErrorMessage: Requests took longer than usual but completed successfully without data loss.
recommendations: Implement Read-Replica connection pooling to offload read-heavy query pressure.
Wrap slow queries in a Redis Cache-Aside pattern with a 60-second TTL.
Configure client-side database query timeout to 2000ms max.

securityFindings.title: Unrestricted Content-Security-Policy Script Execution
securityFindings.observedBehavior: CSP policy header contains 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' directives without cryptographic nonces or SHA-256 hashes.
securityFindings.expectedBehavior: CSP script-src should enforce strict-dynamic with cryptographically random per-request nonces.

evidence.riskVector: Inline script injection possible if user input is reflected into DOM.

securityFindings.potentialImpact: An attacker exploiting a DOM reflection vector could execute arbitrary JavaScript within the victim session.
securityFindings.remediation: Implement nonce-based CSP headers and remove unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval from production responses.
verificationSteps: Verify that script tags require a valid nonce attribute matching the response header.
Verify that inline evaluation with eval() or Function() is rejected by the browser.

securityFindings.title: Missing SameSite Cookie Protection on Session Tokens
securityFindings.observedBehavior: Session cookie does not specify SameSite=Lax or SameSite=Strict attribute, allowing cross-site inclusion on top-level navigations.
securityFindings.expectedBehavior: Session cookies must be set with SameSite=Lax or SameSite=Strict and HttpOnly + Secure flags enabled.
securityFindings.potentialImpact: Vulnerability to cross-site request forgery if combined with state-changing GET or unsynchronized POST endpoints.
securityFindings.remediation: Configure session cookie options with sameSite: "lax" (or "strict") and secure: true.
verificationSteps: Inspect Set-Cookie header in authentication response.
Confirm SameSite=Lax and Secure attributes are present.

securityFindings.title: Unparameterized Query Interpolation in Mock Repository
securityFindings.affectedComponent: Data Access Layer / User Query Endpoint
securityFindings.observedBehavior: User input string is concatenated directly into SQL statement template without parameterized placeholders.
securityFindings.expectedBehavior: All queries must use prepared statements or ORM parameterized methods ($1, ?, or Prisma / TypeORM entity criteria).
securityFindings.potentialImpact: Possibility of SQL injection allowing unauthorized data exfiltration or authentication bypass.
securityFindings.remediation: Replace string interpolation with parameterized queries: client.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1", [email]).
verificationSteps: Submit test input with single quotes and verify the database driver treats it as a literal value without syntax errors.

securityFindings.title: Verbose Server Version Banner Disclosure
securityFindings.observedBehavior: Server header exposes precise runtime version banner (e.g. nginx/1.22.1 / Express 4.19.2).
securityFindings.expectedBehavior: Server and X-Powered-By banners should be omitted or genericized.
securityFindings.potentialImpact: Aids automated vulnerability scanners in pinpointing known unpatched CVEs for this specific software version.
securityFindings.remediation: Disable server_tokens in nginx and call app.disable("x-powered-by") in Express/Fastify.
verificationSteps: Send curl -I request and confirm Server header is absent or generic.

securityFindings.title: Lack of Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoints
securityFindings.observedBehavior: Authentication endpoint does not enforce IP or user-based rate throttling, permitting unbounded consecutive attempts.
securityFindings.expectedBehavior: Enforce rate limiting of maximum 5 attempts per IP/user per 15-minute window with exponential backoff.

evidence.responsesReceived: 20 x 401 Unauthorized without 429 Too Many Requests throttle

securityFindings.potentialImpact: Exposes user accounts to credential stuffing and brute force dictionary attacks.
securityFindings.remediation: Implement Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter (e.g. rate-limiter-flexible or express-rate-limit).
verificationSteps: Simulate 6 rapid login attempts from the same IP and confirm the 6th response returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
